African visitors already account for the bulk of Uganda’s international arrivals. Now the country wants more of them to come for a holiday — or turn a business trip or family visit into one.
Uganda welcomed 1.64 million international tourists in 2025, an almost 20% rise on the previous year, according to the Ministry of Tourism, Wildlife and Antiquities. Travelers from the continent accounted for 79% of arrivals.
